title: openmls 0.x is a public dependency of jmap-chat-mimi-server and jmap-chat-mimi-client, pinned =0.9.1 and no...
description:
Completeness-critic finding: NOT voted by skeptics; verify before acting.

## openmls 0.x is a public dependency of jmap-chat-mimi-server and jmap-chat-mimi-client, pinned =0.9.1 and not re-exported; the planned pin bump (JMAP-6k5d.9) becomes a semver break after 0.4
Crates: jmap-chat-mimi-server, jmap-chat-mimi-client
Evidence: crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server/src/backend.rs:16,191 (`type Crypto: OpenMlsCrypto;` on the public MimiBackend trait); crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server/src/handout.rs:65 (`KeyMaterialRequirements::fit<C: OpenMlsCrypto>`), room.rs:179 (`check_room_create<C: OpenMlsCrypto>`), keypackage.rs:59 (`check_key_package_create<C: OpenMlsCrypto>`); crate-jmap-chat-mimi-client/src/group_info.rs:39-41,132,189 (`verify_group_info_response(crypto: &impl OpenMlsCrypto, ..)`, `group_info_names_hub_sender(&VerifiableGroupInfo, &ExternalSender)`, and VerifiedGroupInfoResponse holds Ciphersuite/ExternalSender/HpkeCiphertext). Both Cargo.toml files pin `openmls = "=0.9.1"`. Neither lib.rs contains `pub use openmls`. AGENTS.md:481 records the public-dependency decision only for serde_json. The rust-api lens's public-dependency check covered reqwest and ed25519_dalek but not openmls. Open bead JMAP-6k5d.9 says to get an openmls upstream fix released and then "bump the pin".
Why breaking later: OpenMlsCrypto, VerifiableGroupInfo, ExternalSender, Ciphersuite and HpkeCiphertext are foreign 0.x types in public trait bounds, pub fn signatures and pub struct fields. Any openmls minor release (0.9 to 0.10) changes these types' identity, so every downstream `impl MimiBackend` (`type Crypto = openmls_rust_crypto::RustCrypto`) and every caller of the client verify functions breaks. These two crates then need a major bump on a schedule set by openmls. Because openmls is not re-exported, downstream must also pin a matching openmls/openmls_rust_crypto version on its own. Keeping the bound but hiding openmls later is itself a break.
Fix: Decide before 0.4, as a recorded constraint. Either (a) accept openmls as a public dependency, document it beside the serde_json decision in AGENTS.md, and add `pub use openmls;` to both crates so implementers name the exact version; or (b) put a crate-owned trait in place of `OpenMlsCrypto` (signature verify and hash, which is all the crates call) and stop exposing openmls types in the client's VerifiedGroupInfoResponse and group_info_names_hub_sender, using bytes or crate-owned newtypes instead. Option (a) is the smaller change. Option (b) is the only one that decouples future openmls bumps.
Size: M
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: option (a) accept openmls as a public dependency. Add pub use openmls; (and pub use openmls_rust_crypto; where its types appear in the public API or docs) to jmap-chat-mimi-server and jmap-chat-mimi-client, and record the public-dependency decision in AGENTS.md beside the serde_json one (the mimi crates take a major bump whenever openmls does).
